title: Centered derandomized BLR acceptance
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\phi:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ be pointwise nonnegative with uniform mean $1$, and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$. Write $F(x)=(-1)^{f(x)}$, and define convolution by $(F*F)(y)=2^{-n}\sum_{z\in\mathbb F_2^n}F(z)F(y-z)$. If the derandomized BLR acceptance probability is obtained by choosing $x$ uniformly and choosing $y$ with density $\phi$ relative to the uniform measure, then
\[2\Pr[ f(x)+f(y)=f(x+y)]-1=\mathbb E_{y\sim\phi}[F(y)(F*F)(y)].\]
